end.summary:
Siya discussed health as physical, mental and social well-being, not only absence of disease.
They identified play, rest or music, and talking with friends or family as examples for the three areas.
They planned practical routine changes: breakfast, less mobile gaming, 15–20 minutes of activity, rest, and social time.
They explained that insufficient sleep may cause tiredness and reduce memory of study material.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Siya practised describing health through physical, mental and social well-being and planning small daily changes. They used examples such as breakfast, reducing three hours of mobile games, short activity, rest, music, and talking with others. Their explanations connected each change to a possible effect, including tiredness from too little sleep. At home, ask them to choose one 15–20 minute activity and explain which area of health it supports.
